info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Management E-Trading Workbench API
info.description: The Investment Management E-Trading Workbench API facilitates the execution and management of trading activities for investment portfolios. This API allows users to initiate trades, access trading tools, and manage investment strategies programmatically. Typical consumers include financial institutions and asset managers looking to enhance their trading operations and streamline investment workflow. By leveraging this API, users can improve efficiency in trading processes and provide better services to their clients.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new E-Trading Workbench in the investment management system, enabling them to manage and streamline their trading activities effectively.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating a trade or managing investment activities. It contains relevant information required for processing the transaction or request within the e-trading workbench.
